author: SlayerPipeDaddy
quote:
GTA used to be about doing whatever you want to whoever you want and as being as offensive as possible. Not anymore.

The map and level of detail are phenomenal and worth playing at least once. Easily the best world handcrafted hands down.

But the game does not innovate or push boundaries like in previous games. Too many freedoms have been taken away. The game punishes you with a morality system (even though it’s all criminal behaviour) based on your playstyle, in fear you will unlock a ‘bad ending’

No hookers, no other romance options
Can’t steal a neighbours car
Can’t let trains run people over or have alligator's eat people 
NPCs are superficial, no more immersive than RDR2
Jason is a doormat

I think there has been negative misinformation spread that Lucia cheats and you can’t kill protesters that doesn’t make the game better for me knowing this isn’t true.

I think the culture change at Rockstar during the dev cycle really hurt the game, hardcore fans feel Dan Housers absence in the writing, though I wouldn’t have guessed if I didn’t know.

I don’t mean to bash it but it gets enough glazing as it does.

We waited 13 for this and at the end of the day it comes down to whether or not it lived up to the hype and for me it didn’t. If Rockstar can charge 150 dollars for RDR3.0 I can rate this a 0/10. 

Also **** Metacritic from changing my rating to an 8.
